title: From Classifier Heads to Encoder Prototypes: Personalized Federated Learning with Head-Derived Clustering
abstract: arXiv:2610.30075v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Personalized federated learning must decide which clients should share representations. We introduce HDC-FL (Head-Derived Clustering for Personalized Federated Learning), which reads that decision off a signal shared-encoder training already produces: the client-specific classifi- er heads. At periodic refresh rounds the server projects the cached heads into a normalized low-rank descriptor space, groups the descriptors, builds one encoder prototype per group from the cached client encoders, and returns to each client a soft mixture of those prototypes paired with its own unchanged head. Client-specific heads are never averaged or distributed to oth- er clients; the shared-encoder trajectory is left intact; and no second optimization trajectory, additional local objective, or post-training fine-tuning stage is required. Across 11 CIFAR-10 and CIFAR-100 configurations covering label-subset, Dirichlet and rotation heterogeneity with ResNet

translated_title: 从分类器头到编码器原型：基于分类器头聚类的个性化联邦学习
translated_abstract: 个性化联邦学习必须决定哪些客户端应当共享表示。我们提出了HDC-FL（基于分类器头聚类的个性化联邦学习），该方法从共享编码器训练已经产生的信号——客户端特有的分类器头——中读取这一决策。在周期性的刷新轮次中，服务器将缓存的分类器头投影到归一化的低秩描述符空间中，对描述符进行聚类分组，从缓存的客户端编码器中为每组构建一个编码器原型，并向每个客户端返回这些原型的软混合，同时保留其自身不变的分类器头。客户端特有的分类器头从不被平均或分发给其他客户端；共享编码器的训练轨迹保持不变；并且无需引入第二条优化轨迹、额外的本地目标函数或训练后的微调阶段。在涵盖标签子集、Dirichlet分布和旋转异质性的11个CIFAR-10和CIFAR-100配置上，使用ResNet……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: HDC-FL利用联邦学习训练中已有的客户端分类器头进行聚类分组，为每组构建编码器原型并以软混合形式返回给客户端，无需平均分类器头、额外优化或微调即可实现个性化表示共享。
en_tdlr: HDC-FL leverages client-specific classifier heads—signals already produced by shared-encoder training—to cluster clients and build per-group encoder prototypes delivered as soft mixtures, enabling personalized representation sharing without averaging heads, extra objectives, or fine-tuning.
